_about: THE ONE PLACE for this site's links and facts. Edit here, then run: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify.mjs, commit, push.
_optInLive: false = the Play closed test is not published yet: steps 2-3 on join.html are dimmed with a note (step 1, the shared group, always works). Set true once Play Console > Testing > Closed testing (Korea) is 'Available to testers', then rebuild + push.
_appStoreUrl: empty = App Store badge is a disabled 'coming soon' badge (no link). Put the apps.apple.com URL here when the iOS app is live.
